rationale: Charlie's conviction that AI is expanding who can build software aligns directly with Grady's experience proving non-technical founders can build impactful startups—Grady built NightWare through FDA approval and DoD/VA commercialization without a technical background. While they operate in different domains (developer tools vs. digital therapeutics), Grady's 15+ years in Silicon Valley and expertise in regulatory strategy and enterprise commercialization could offer valuable perspective on scaling platforms responsibly as Expo targets the next wave of AI-enabled builders.
intro_message: Charlie Cheever, meet Grady Hannah — both believe AI is unlocking new builders, and Grady's experience navigating FDA and enterprise sales for breakthrough medical devices offers a complementary lens on scaling responsibly as Expo powers the next generation of creators.
